name: EDLR 6050
title: Dissertation Proposal/Prospectus Development I
description: Open to advanced students enrolled in doctoral programs. Systematic development of dissertation proposal components, including introduction, problem statement, conceptual framework and/or review of literature, and research questions. IRB and ethical considerations, and preparations for proposal defense. May include methodology/methods, pilot study, limitations, and related appendices depending on student needs. May be repeated for up to six credits. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Instructor and major advisor consent; completion of program or concentration General Examination, or comprehensive literature reviews in area of study.
